strings.Settings.Language.Title: Language
strings.Settings.Language.Description: The app scans JSON files in the Languages folder automatically. Copy an existing file and edit code, displayName, and strings to add a language.
strings.Browser.Title: Browser and platform
strings.Browser.HeadlessDescription: In headless mode, enter a target URL directly. A visible sign-in window opens automatically when login expires.
strings.Browser.UrlWatermark: Enter an author page, short link, or a URL from shared text
strings.Browser.ChromiumPathHint: Chromium is installed in the chromium folder beside the executable.
strings.Browser.ChromiumDownloadFailed: Chromium installation failed with exit code {0}
strings.Capture.Title: Collection strategy
strings.Capture.StopOnDuplicate: Stop after consecutive previously downloaded works
strings.Capture.DuplicateThresholdHint: Default: 20. The counter resets when a new work is found.
strings.Download.Title: Download settings
strings.Download.PageDelay: After every page is processed, wait randomly for 3–10 seconds before loading the next page.
strings.Download.SpeedLimitDescription: Sets the total speed limit for work media downloads; 0 means unlimited. Concurrent videos, images, audio, and HLS segments share this limit. Chromium and FFmpeg component installation is not affected.
strings.Download.ImageCacheDescription: Deletes only avatars and cover images in image-cache. Downloaded works, history, settings, and browser login data are preserved.
strings.Download.CheckAudio: Detect audio and repair silent videos automatically
strings.Download.CheckAudioDescription: Off by default. When enabled, ffprobe checks each downloaded video. If it is silent and background music is available, the app downloads the audio temporarily and merges it with ffmpeg.
strings.Download.CheckAudioImpact: Impact: audio detection waits for each video; silent videos also require audio download and merging, so author downloads take longer.
strings.Download.FfmpegDescription: The app downloads the latest FFmpeg release essentials archive from gyan.dev in the background and extracts ffmpeg.exe and ffprobe.exe to ffmpeg\bin. No browser window is opened.
strings.Download.PersonDetection: Person detection: delete images without people
strings.Download.PersonDetectionConfidenceDescri: Default: 60%. Higher values are stricter and reduce false positives, but distant, small, or blurry people are more likely to be missed.
strings.Download.PersonDetectionDescription: Off by default. Images are saved as .pending and sent to the YoloDotNet background queue. Images containing people are restored; others are deleted. Put person-detection.onnx or yolo11?.onnx in the Models folder.
strings.Download.PersonDetectionImpact: Impact: this uses additional CPU, memory, and disk resources and can delay final statistics and notifications.
strings.PushPlus.Title: WeChat notification
strings.PushPlus.Description: Enter a PushPlus token to send one notification when this author has newly downloaded works. Leave blank to disable.
strings.Remote.Title: Remote control server
strings.Remote.Description: Disabling it stops the listening port immediately. Android, iOS, and web clients will no longer connect.
strings.Remote.SaveToken: Save and activate the new token
strings.Remote.TokenHint: Use 4–64 letters, numbers, or . _ @ -. Web and mobile clients must reconnect with the new token.
strings.Log.Title: Runtime log
strings.History.Title: Download history
strings.History.Hint: Newest first · Right-click actions · Drag to reorder
strings.History.FileHint: History is stored in History.json beside the application executable.
strings.History.SearchPlaceholder: Enter author name, ID, or platform
strings.Dialog.Stop.Title: Stop collection?
strings.Dialog.Stop.Message: The current collection and download tasks will stop. Unfinished works will not continue downloading.
strings.Dialog.Exit.Title: Exit HelloCrab?
strings.Dialog.Exit.Message: Closing the app stops current collection and download tasks.
strings.Dialog.Delete.Title: Delete author record?
strings.Dialog.Delete.Message: Remove it only from history, or also delete the author's files from disk.
strings.Status.BrowserVisible: Visible mode: NoViewport follows the browser window size
strings.Status.BrowserLoginRecovery: Temporary visible mode: waiting for sign-in; headless 1440×900 resumes automatically
strings.Status.LanguageReloaded: Languages folder rescanned. {0} language packs found.
strings.Dialog.Delete.Author: Author: {0} (UID: {1})
strings.Schedule.Title: Scheduled automatic downloads
strings.Schedule.Description: Scheduled downloads run headlessly in the background by default without opening a browser window. A visible browser appears only when login has expired. At the scheduled time, authors are recollected in history order, and the saved plan is restored after the app restarts.
strings.Schedule.Log.Restored: Scheduled automatic downloads restored. Next run: {0}
strings.Schedule.Log.BatchBusy: The schedule fired while another task was running, so this run was skipped.
strings.Schedule.Log.NoHistory: The schedule fired, but the history list is empty.
strings.Schedule.Log.BatchStarted: Scheduled automatic download started. {0} authors will be processed in history order.
strings.Schedule.Log.ItemInvalidUrl: Skipped “{0}”: no valid author page URL was found.
strings.Schedule.Log.LoginRequired: Login expired while processing “{0}”. Complete login in the visible browser; remaining history tasks were paused.
strings.Schedule.Log.BatchCompleted: Scheduled automatic download completed: {0}/{1} history tasks processed.
strings.Schedule.Log.BatchCanceled: Scheduled automatic download stopped: {0}/{1} history tasks processed.
strings.Schedule.Log.CancelRequested: Stop requested for the scheduled download batch. No later history tasks will be processed after the current author stops.
strings.Schedule.Log.OverlapSkipped: The previous scheduled download is still running, so this repeated trigger was skipped.
strings.Schedule.Log.HeadlessMode: Scheduled automatic downloads run headlessly in the background. A browser window appears only when login has expired.
strings.Download.FfmpegNotFound: FFmpeg was not detected. Download it before checking or repairing video audio tracks.
strings.Download.FfmpegUnsupported: Automatic FFmpeg download is not supported on this platform. Install it with the system package manager.
strings.Download.PersonDetectionModelMissing: No YOLO model was found. Put person-detection.onnx, yolo11.onnx, or a yolo11 ONNX model with one trailing letter in the Models folder beside the application.
strings.Log.Component.ChromiumMissing: Chromium was not found. Click “Install Chromium” before first use.
strings.Log.Component.FfmpegMissing: FFmpeg was not found. Click “Download FFmpeg” before enabling video audio-track detection.
strings.Log.Component.YoloMissing: No YOLO model was found. When person detection is enabled, detection will be skipped and images will be kept. Check the Models folder beside the application.
strings.Log.Component.CheckFailed: Failed to check Chromium, FFmpeg, and YOLO components: {0}
strings.Remote.Status.Stopped: Stopped · Mobile and web clients cannot connect
strings.Remote.Log.StartFailed: Failed to start the remote control service: {0}
strings.Remote.Log.Stopped: The remote control service stopped and the port is no longer listening.
strings.Remote.Log.ToggleFailed: Failed to change the remote control server state: {0}
strings.Remote.Api.TokenInvalid: The remote access token is incorrect.
strings.Remote.Api.SettingsSaved: Settings saved. The desktop UI and settings.json are now synchronized.
strings.Remote.Api.InstallChromiumAccepted: The Chromium installation task has started. Check the runtime log for progress.
strings.Remote.Api.NoCaptureRunning: No collection task is currently running.
strings.Remote.Api.CannotOpenFolder: The download folder cannot be opened in the current state.
strings.Remote.Api.FolderOpened: The download folder was opened on the host.
strings.Remote.Api.ActionUnavailable: This action cannot be performed in the current state.
strings.Ffmpeg.Status.Downloading: Downloading and installing FFmpeg in the background…
strings.Ffmpeg.Log.Starting: Opening the gyan.dev FFmpeg Windows builds page and downloading the release essentials ZIP. Download percentage, size, and speed will be shown here.
strings.Ffmpeg.Log.NoRestart: No restart is required. The newly installed tools will be used the next time video audio-track detection is enabled.
